title: Nation Media Hackathon 2025
description: Participated in Nation Media Group's premier hackathon focused on 'Reimagining Media through Technology.' Developed innovative solutions addressing real-world challenges in journalism and media industry including immersive storytelling, multi-platform content delivery, personalized news experiences, interactive data visualization, new revenue models, and audience engagement strategies. Demonstrated MediaTech & prototyping skills with working solutions for commercial journalism challenges.
achievements: Developed MediaTech prototype, applied AI in newsrooms, demonstrated audience retention solutions

title: AI Hackathon at ABC Place 2025
description: Competed in Kenya's major national AI competition focusing on 'Ethical and Responsible AI' for high-impact sectors. Developed AI solutions addressing governance and compliance, risk management, threat detection & prevention, and leveraging Generative/Agentic AI for localized solutions in FinTech, Public Policy, and Sustainable Development. Emphasized transparency, explainability, fairness, and preventing bias in AI systems.
achievements: Built ethical AI system for financial fraud detection with model fairness and transparency

title: Code Africa 2025
description: Attended Africa's premier software development conference focusing on emerging technologies and ecosystem growth across the continent. Participated in workshops covering Blockchain and Web3, AI/Machine Learning, IoT, Big Data, DevOps, and Cybersecurity. The event emphasized driving African contributions to the global tech landscape and connecting with founders, VCs, and industry pioneers across Africa.
achievements: Gained Web3 fundamentals, Big Data solutions expertise, networked with African tech ecosystem

title: TEMS Africa Expo 2025
description: Participated in Africa's premier ICT Exhibition and Conference focusing on Information and Communication Technology for African growth and transformation. Explored B2B solutions in 5G and Wireless Communication, Cloud Computing, Cybersecurity, E-Government/E-Commerce, IoT, and Digital Transformation across Banking, Healthcare, and Government sectors. Gained insights into commercial and policy aspects of technology.
achievements: Learned enterprise-level solutions, understood ICT's role in national development, gained strategic tech perspective
